# Auto-generated files — ownership map

This file lists every committed mod file whose contents are produced by a generator script. **Do not hand-edit these files.** Edit the generator's input source and re-run the generator instead.

Quick check while exploring: a file is generator-owned if its first 5 lines contain `# AUTO-GENERATED` or `do not edit manually`. To list all marked files:

```bash
git grep -l "AUTO-GENERATED\|do not edit manually" common/ map_data/ localization/
```

## Mod scripting & data

The scripts in this section auto-run inside `mod_state_server.py` after every full `/reload` (see `POST_LOAD_GENERATORS` and `_run_post_load_generators`). Manual invocation remains useful for `--dry-run` or when iterating on the script itself; set `VIC3_SKIP_POST_LOAD_GENERATORS=1` to disable the auto-run.

| File / glob | Owner script | Input | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `common/ideologies/modified.txt` | `apply_ideologies.py` | `ideology_modifications.py` + vanilla `common/ideologies/*.txt` | Re-run after vanilla updates to pull in new vanilla laws/attitudes (e.g. 1.13 added `law_social_monarchy`). The python file holds the *delta* the mod imposes; vanilla files are the baseline. An ideology whose delta only adds blocks vanilla lacks is an `INJECT` of them; one that touches a block vanilla has is a `REPLACE` of vanilla's whole entry (an `INJECT` of that block would show the law group twice in the tooltip). Without the game, `scripts/generators/regen_ideologies_offline.py` regenerates it (and the law-consistency file) from `vanilla_parsed/`; `test_apply_ideologies.py` fails when it is stale. |
| `common/interest_groups/zz_te_ig_female_chance.txt` | `ig_feminism.py` | profiles in `ig_feminism.py` + vanilla `common/interest_groups/*.txt` | One `INJECT` per vanilla interest group, for its three `female_*_chance` script values. An injected script value replaces vanilla's whole field, so each restates vanilla's lines from the game files, then adds the profile's law and technology branches. Needs the game files to regenerate; `test_ig_feminism.py` fails when it is stale. |
| `common/parties/zz_te_party_join_weights.txt` | `scripts/generators/gen_party_join_weights.py` | vanilla `common/parties/*.txt` | One `INJECT` per vanilla party (not the revolutionary party), for its `join_weight`, with the First Past the Post terms (a bonus for the two largest parties in place of vanilla's party-size multipliers, whose opening `if` becomes an `else_if`; a penalty for the rest at the end). An injected `join_weight` replaces vanilla's whole field, so each restates vanilla's lines from the game files, minus vanilla's `usa_two_party_system` terms. Not run on `/reload`; needs the game files (`--check` exits 1 when stale). `test_first_past_the_post.py` fails when the committed file doesn't match a fresh generation from the lines it restates, or when a restated line differs from `vanilla_parsed/common/parties.json` (#1164) in a value, a desc, a dropped or added line, or the order within one key. The snapshot keeps no order across keys, so a restated `else_if` moved under another `if`, or a step moved past a term of another key, passes CI; only `--check` catches it, or the test's game-files comparison, which runs only where the game is installed. |

| `localization/english/te_*_l_english.yml` (32 category files as of 2026-10; grows with new content families) | `organize_loc.py` | every other `*_l_english.yml` under `localization/english/` | Categorises and sorts every key. When you introduce a brand-new content family (new key prefix), add a `startswith` rule in `categorize_key` and a category in `CATEGORIES` — otherwise its keys silently land in MISCELLANEOUS and any pre-existing dedicated file gets dropped on next run. The tax-code probes shipped in #585 without one, so the next run deleted `te_debug_tax_l_english.yml` and spread its keys over five files; CI's `python3 organize_loc.py --check` now fails on any loc file a run would change, so run organize_loc and commit its result. A disposable debug harness that must stay in its own file, unused keys included, also goes in `HARNESS_CATEGORIES`; a file a generator also writes goes in `GENERATED_CATEGORIES` (category -> marker), which keeps its keys there and writes the `AUTO-GENERATED` marker into the section comment (the only place a comment survives a run); the generator renders through `section_label` so both writers agree byte for byte (`te_tax_generated_l_english.yml`). **`te_buildings_l_english.yml` is also written by `gen_vanilla_company_buildings.py`** (one-shot, see § "One-shot generator outputs" below); the auto-run order matters — run organize_loc.py *after* gen_vanilla_company_buildings.py to fold the appended keys into their final category file. The mod_state_server post-load chain handles this automatically. |

## Budget display (explicit regeneration)

Run `python3 scripts/generators/gen_budget_breakdown.py` after changing its income
or expense catalogue or adding an institution. It reads the committed vanilla
institution and modifier-type snapshots and mod definitions, and writes:

| File | Owner script | Input |
|---|---|---|
| `common/script_values/te_budget_generated_values.txt` | `scripts/generators/gen_budget_breakdown.py` | Institution roster and budget catalogue |
| `gui/te_budget_generated_charts.gui` | `scripts/generators/gen_budget_breakdown.py` | Same roster/catalogue and Cultural Hegemony palette |
| `common/modifier_type_definitions/te_budget_generated_types.txt` | `scripts/generators/gen_budget_breakdown.py` | Accounting mirrors for each system's recurring monetary modifiers; each copies its native type's `decimals` and prefix from `vanilla_parsed/common/modifier_types.json` |
| `localization/english/te_budget_l_english.yml` | `scripts/generators/gen_budget_breakdown.py` | Generator's labels, the mirrors' tooltip names ("Counted in the Budget Breakdown under …") and institution allocation tooltips |

This generator runs explicitly; it is not a post-load regenerator. The localization
organizer preserves its BUDGET family and output format.

Flags bracket-style formatting tags (`[b]`, `[/i]`, …) in loc values — Vic3 has no such tags, so each one log-spams and lags the panel rendering it — nested `[...]` inside `[...]`, which makes the whole value fail to parse, a `$key$` that pastes `[` or `'` into a quoted data-function argument, and a straight apostrophe in a modifier or modifier-type name (pasted unescaped into the add-modifier tooltip's quoted argument). |
| `docs/engine/any_limit_report.md` | `any_limit_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags `limit = { }` as an immediate child of an `any_*` counting trigger (silently ignored → meaning flip), and `always = no` / `always = false` in the same place (always false). |
| `docs/engine/pm_employment_report.md` | `pm_employment_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags professions whose employment total goes negative in some valid PM combination. |
| `docs/engine/orphaned_event_report.md` | `orphaned_event_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags non-self-firing events defined but never referenced by any dispatch path. |
| `docs/engine/effect_trigger_validity_report.md` | `effect_trigger_validity_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags effect/trigger keywords not in the engine catalog (and `funcname(...)` call-syntax), and effects in trigger context or triggers in effect context (#1142), across every directory in the audit's `SCAN_ROOTS` — events, scripted helpers, on-actions and the script-bearing `common/` entity dirs (#288/#295). |
| `docs/engine/iterator_limit_report.md` | `iterator_limit_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags an `every_*`/`random_*`/`ordered_*`/`any_*` block whose `limit = { }` sits after an effect sibling — an iterator's limit filters the whole iteration, so that earlier effect is gated too. |
| `docs/engine/modifier_multiplier_var_report.md` | `modifier_multiplier_var_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a permanent `add_modifier { multiplier = var:X }` followed by `remove_variable = X` in the same top-level block — the stored multiplier re-evaluates to `'none'` — and a multiplier reading a building's own variable (buildings hold none). |
| `docs/engine/je_multiplier_scope_report.md` | `je_multiplier_scope_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags country-only reads in JE modifier multipliers, tracing named script values and scripted triggers transitively against the committed engine scope catalogs. |
| `docs/engine/duplicate_key_report.md` | `duplicate_key_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags repeated scalar keys *inside* one block — the engine's own duplicate warning only covers top-level entity collisions (issues #190, #191). |
| `docs/engine/attitude_key_report.md` | `attitude_key_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags `attitude = <bareword>` values outside the engine's fixed 15-key catalog; an unknown key never matches, so the gate keyed on it is dead code. |
| `docs/engine/event_image_report.md` | `event_image_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags visible events with no `event_image` and no alternate art (`gui_window` / `left_icon` / `right_icon`); the default event window has no fallback, so they render a magenta placeholder silently. |
| `docs/engine/treaty_leverage_side_report.md` | `treaty_leverage_side_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a directed treaty article carrying `country_treaty_leverage_generation_add` on the same side that pays `maintenance_paid_by` — the modifier generates leverage *against* its carrier, so that inverts the influence with no engine diagnostic. |
| `docs/engine/event_context_report.md` | `event_context_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags events whose text does not match the context they fire in — `system_ungated` (talks about a mod system without reading its state or being gated on it), `unchosen_self_action` (claims the recipient's own action though it can arrive unchosen), `imputed_foreign_action` (picks another country, says it acted, punishes it). Heuristic ranking with each flag's dispatch sites. Suppress with a check-tagged `# REVIEWED YYYY-MM-DD (<check>): rationale` line inside the event. |
| `docs/engine/silent_variable_report.md` | `silent_variable_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags options of visible mod events that write a variable the UI displays (mod loc / GUI `Var`, `GetVariable`, `GetGlobalVariable`, or a `ScriptValue` reading it) outside any tooltip — `change_variable` renders nothing, so the option reads as doing less than it does. Check-tagged suppression inside the option: `# REVIEWED YYYY-MM-DD (silent_variable): rationale`. |
| `docs/engine/prev_scope_report.md` | `prev_scope_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a `prev` that resolves to a scope named two blocks up (`root`, `scope:x`, …) inside a further scope, where it is almost always meant to be the outer scope. No engine diagnostic. `python3 prev_scope_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/container_timed_variable_report.md` | `container_timed_variable_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a timed `set_variable` (`days`/`months`/…) on a script container — the engine never expires it there, so the variable stays set for good. No engine diagnostic. `python3 container_timed_variable_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/je_immediate_reset_report.md` | `je_immediate_reset_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a non-idempotent, unguarded write (`set_variable` to a value, `change_variable`, `remove_variable`, a list clear) in a mod journal entry's `immediate`, directly or through a scripted effect — `immediate` re-runs on re-activation and on every entry a revolution's winner inherits, so it silently resets the player's state. No engine diagnostic. `python3 je_immediate_reset_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/gui_reference_report.md` | `gui_reference_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Cross-checks GUI references, saved scopes, widget mounts, BOM, braces and duplicate `visible`; warns for unavailable vanilla categories, dynamic scope bindings and saved-scope reads in `is_shown`. CLI prints only; CI uses `--strict` (errors only). |
| `docs/engine/script_loc_reference_report.md` | `script_loc_reference_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags loc keys named in script (`desc = "KEY"` on a breakdown line, `custom_tooltip = KEY`, event `title`, …) that no vanilla or mod loc file defines — the engine prints the raw key with no warning. |
| `docs/engine/empty_effect_report.md` | `empty_effect_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags script that runs and does nothing: an `if` / `else_if` holding only its `limit` at the end of its chain, an empty `else` or an iterator with nothing to run (`empty_block`), and an event option that executes nothing beside one that does (`no_effect_option`). No engine diagnostic. Check-tagged suppression. `python3 empty_effect_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/change_variable_clamp_report.md` | `change_variable_clamp_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a `min =` / `max =` directly inside `change_variable` (or its global / local twins). Vanilla never writes it and the direction is a guess (`max = N` caps in a script value, so `max = 0` meant as a floor caps at 0 instead); use `clamp_variable` with both bounds or an explicit `if`. No engine diagnostic. `python3 change_variable_clamp_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/building_scope_variable_report.md` | `building_scope_variable_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags variable operations and bare `var:X` reads whose current scope is a building, including saved aliases. `python3 building_scope_variable_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/principle_tier_report.md` | `principle_tier_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a power bloc principle tier that drops, moves, weakens or changes a modifier the tier below it carried, since tiers replace rather than add; also a modifier in the wrong block (`power_bloc_*` outside `power_bloc_modifier`, anything else inside it) and a modifier block opened twice. |
| `docs/engine/prestige_good_roster_report.md` | `prestige_good_roster_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a prestige good whose base good no building in the company's `building_types` produces (`not_produced`, or `extension_only` when only an extension building does); the prestige good never appears. Also flags a mod prestige good on a `local = yes` base good (`local_base_good`), which does nothing. No engine diagnostic. `python3 prestige_good_roster_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/amendment_reachability_report.md` | `amendment_reachability_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a mod amendment no script attaches: `unreachable` (no `add_amendment`, no possible sponsor), `sponsor_only` (only interest-group sponsorship in an enactment negotiation attaches it), `dead_adds_only` (every `add_amendment` in an orphaned event or an uncalled scripted effect), `unknown_allowed_law`, and `unknown_type` for an `add_amendment` naming no amendment. No engine diagnostic. `python3 amendment_reachability_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/ideology_lawgroup_report.md` | `ideology_lawgroup_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags an ideology lawgroup block that leaves a law out (`missing_law`: mod ideologies and mod-added blocks name every law, vanilla blocks the laws the mod adds; variant and carrier laws exempt), and on mod-touched ideologies `unknown_lawgroup`, `unknown_law`, `wrong_group`, `bad_stance` and `variant_stance`. A left-out law is implicitly neutral. `python3 ideology_lawgroup_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/script_argument_report.md` | `script_argument_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a scripted effect or trigger call that passes an argument the callee's body never names, or leaves out a `$X$` it names, which the engine refuses to compile; dispatcher calls (`helper_$KIND$ = { … }`) are checked at each helper they reach. Vanilla callees only when the game files are on disk. `python3 script_argument_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI (mod callees). |
| `docs/engine/modifier_duration_report.md` | `modifier_duration_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags an `add_modifier`'s `days` / `months` / `years` / `weeks` given anything but a number or a script value written as a bare number: the engine reads one written as a block (`{ value = N }`), or computed, as 0 days (the Planned Capital option's "for 0 days", 2026-10-23). Follows a scripted effect's `$X$` duration to its callers. No engine diagnostic. `python3 modifier_duration_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/loc_script_value_report.md` | `loc_script_value_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a `ScriptValue('name')` in a `localization/english/` value, or in a quoted string in a script file under `common/` or `events/` (comments aside), whose name is no script value in the mod's `common/script_values/` or vanilla's (`vanilla_parsed/` snapshot); the text renders `0`, and only debug.log says why. Skips `te_unused_l_english.yml` and non-literal arguments; `.gui` reads are `gui_reference_audit`'s. `python3 loc_script_value_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI. |
| `docs/engine/texture_reference_report.md` | `texture_reference_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags an asset path in `common/`, `events/` or `gui/` that resolves to no file in the mod's tracked `gfx/` or vanilla's (`game/`, `jomini/`, `clausewitz/` and DLC `gfx/`), one that resolves only in another casing, a `video = name` that names no media alias, and a path not from `gfx/`, with an unknown extension, `\` separators or spaces around it, and a mod entity that declares no art field its type needs (`undeclared`: a building's `background`, a static modifier's `icon`, ...); DLC-only paths warn. The engine logs a miss only on first render. `python3 texture_reference_audit.py --strict` runs it in CI against the catalog below. |
| `docs/engine/long_tooltip_report.md` | `long_tooltip_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a loc key a mod `.gui` names (`text`, `tooltip`, `Localize`, `SelectLocalization`) outside a How-it-works section whose rendered text runs over 500 characters (#1213, the GUI audit's finding 7). `python3 long_tooltip_audit.py --strict` runs it offline, as CI does. |
| `docs/engine/hidden_modifier_report.md` | `hidden_modifier_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a `custom_tooltip` (or `custom_description`) whose text renders no `GetStaticModifier` for an `add_modifier` it wraps, so the modifier's lines never show (#1213, finding 4). `python3 hidden_modifier_audit.py --strict` runs it offline, as CI does. |
| `docs/engine/button_reason_report.md` | `button_reason_audit.py` | server start + `POST /reload` (post-load chain). Flags a button enabled by a scripted GUI's `IsValid` whose tooltip prints no `IsValidTooltip` (`missing_reason`), and a rendered `is_valid` or a scripted button's `possible` test that prints as raw script (`raw_condition`) (#1213, finding 5; style rule 6). `python3 button_reason_audit.py --strict` runs it offline, as CI does. |
| `docs/audits/mod_only_tech_modifier_baseline.md` | `scripts/analysis/tech_balance_audit.py --refresh-baseline` | manual run; row-level `target_typical_value` cells are then hand-edited |
| `docs/data/tech_modifier_baseline.json`, `docs/data/tech_modifier_pattern_baseline.json` | `scripts/analysis/tech_modifier_baseline.py` | refreshed via `scripts/analysis/tech_balance_audit.py --refresh-baseline` |
| `docs/data/balance_snapshot.json` | `scripts/snapshot_balance.py` | manual run; snapshot before vanilla bumps |

## Deploy-time outputs (not committed)

Generated on every `scripts/deploy.sh` run into the gitignored `build/` folder, then synced into the Paradox mod folder. They never appear in the repo, so there is nothing to hand-edit; change the English source.

| Deployed as | Staged at | Owner script | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `localization/<language>/**/*_l_<language>.yml` for the ten non-English game languages | `build/localization/<language>/` | `scripts/generators/gen_non_english_loc.py` | A copy of every file under `localization/english/` (`replace/` included), byte-identical apart from the `l_<language>:` header and the file-name suffix, except that a language with a translation memory (`i18n/<language>/tm/*.json`, written by `scripts/i18n/translate_loc.py merge`) has each translated value swapped in and its declined country-name forms (`<TAG>_NOM`, …) added after the base key. Untranslated keys, and keys whose English changed beyond a small tweak, stay English. Edit translations in the TM, never in the staged `.yml`; see `i18n/README.md`. The game shows raw keys, not English, for a key the player's language lacks. The deploy watcher ignores `build/`; the main rsync excludes these folders so its `--delete` leaves them alone. |

## "One-shot generator" outputs (committed; may be hand-edited afterwards)

These are written by scripts that the team runs occasionally to *bootstrap* content. After bootstrap, the committed file is the source of truth and can be hand-edited. Re-running a generator may overwrite hand edits or, for `gen_vanilla_company_buildings.py`, duplicate everything it wrote — see each row.

| File | Generator | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/engine/effect_trigger_valid_keys.txt` | `effect_trigger_validity_audit.py bootstrap` | Re-run on a vanilla bump (see `vanilla_patch_runbook.md` § 4). Frozen union of effect/trigger summary names + every LHS keyword vanilla uses across the audit's `SCAN_ROOTS` (entity definition names and static-modifier block bodies excluded). Re-bootstrapping shrinks each `ScanRoot.extra_valid`, which exists to cover schema fields the current catalog predates. NOT regenerated per reload, and NOT meant to be hand-edited — add valid-but-vanilla-unused keys to `_CURATED_VALID` in the audit instead. |
| `docs/engine/vanilla_asset_paths.txt` | `texture_reference_audit.py --bootstrap` | Re-run on a vanilla bump (see `vanilla_patch_runbook.md` § 4). Every file under the install's `game/gfx`, `jomini/gfx`, `clausewitz/gfx` and `game/dlc/*/gfx` with an `ASSET_EXTENSIONS` extension, as the engine mounts it (`gfx/...`), then every media alias name (`media_alias:<name>`); a tab-separated second column lists DLC origins. Stands in for the install in CI and cloud sessions. NOT regenerated per reload; a reload with the game warns `catalog_stale` when it differs from the install, and `test_texture_reference_audit` fails CI when its header's game version isn't `vanilla_parsed/manifest.json`'s. |
| `docs/engine/effect_trigger_context_keys.txt` | `effect_trigger_validity_audit.py bootstrap-context` | Re-run on a vanilla bump (see `vanilla_patch_runbook.md` § 4). Frozen `[effect_only]` / `[trigger_only]` name sets for the audit's context check (#1142): names in `effects.log` and not `triggers.log` (or the reverse), plus vanilla's scripted effects / triggers, less every LHS keyword vanilla's `common/` + `events/` use in the other context. Engine docs from `vanilla_snapshot_docs_path`, usage from the live install. NOT regenerated per reload, and NOT meant to be hand-edited. |
| `localization_accessor_vanilla_extras.py` | `scripts/generators/fold_vanilla_loc_accessors.py` | live vanilla `game/localization/english/` | Re-run on a vanilla bump (see `vanilla_patch_runbook.md` § 4). Folds every accessor the loc accessor audit flags on vanilla loc back in as value-returning; `test_vanilla_loc_has_minimal_unreviewed_flags` fails when stale. Type-changing accessors belong in `_BUILTIN_ACCESSORS_BY_TYPE` in `localization_accessor_audit.py` instead. |
| `common/buildings/company_buildings.txt` | `scripts/generators/gen_vanilla_company_buildings.py` | Since 2026-10-02 the generator exits without writing once this file holds its "Phase 7" section, since a second run would duplicate everything it appends. |
| `common/production_method_groups/unique_pm_groups.txt` | `scripts/generators/gen_vanilla_company_buildings.py` | The generator only appends its own section. `pmg_disney_world`, `pmg_generic_industrial_city` and `pmg_generic_monument_to_industry` are hand-edited to list the `free_market_construction_rule` twins (`te_construction_market_pms.txt`); keep those lines when regenerating. |
| `common/production_methods/unique_pms.txt` | `scripts/generators/gen_vanilla_company_buildings.py` | Note: was hand-edited during the 1.13 migration. The generator appends unconditionally to all five of its files, so a second run duplicates every building, PMG, PM, INJECT and loc key it wrote.
